title: On two open points in Part IV of Ramanujan's Lost Notebook: the domain of Entry 12.2.3 and a summation reading of Entry 19.2.2
description: A short note on two places in Andrews and Berndt, Ramanujan's Lost Notebook, Part IV, where a question is left open. (1) For Entry 12.2.3, L(s,χ)L(s−r,χ) = Σ χ(n)σ_r(n)n^(−s) with χ the non-principal character modulo 4, the authors expect validity for Re s > sup{0, Re r}. This fails for r = 0: the abscissa of convergence of Σ χ(n)d(n)n^(−s) lies in [1/4, 1/3], so the series diverges for 0 < Re s < 1/4. The lower bound follows from classical Ω-results (Landau; Chandrasekharan–Narasimhan); we derive it from the mean-square theorem of Cao, Tanigawa and Zhai, whose hypotheses are checked, and the upper bound from de Roton. (2) Entry 19.2.2, which the authors call false because it contains divergent series, also fails when the series Σ σ_s(n) sin(nα) is read by Abel summation (s < −2, α/2π a quadratic irrational); numerically the Abel value has poles at rational α/2π. The record contains the 5-page note, a Python verification script (10 checks), an offline calculator and the figure code. No new methods are claimed.
